zh: 您的订单号是多少？
old_en: What is your order number?
new_en: What is your order number?

zh: 请告诉我您的账号，好吗？
old_en: Could you please tell me your account number?
new_en: Could you please tell me your account number?

zh: 您遇到了什么问题呢？
old_en: What issue are you facing?
new_en: What problem are you having?

zh: 请问您遇到了什么困难？
old_en: Could you tell me what difficulties you've encountered?
new_en: What difficulty are you facing?

zh: 处理需要大概五分钟时间。
old_en: It will take about five minutes to process, your patience please.
new_en: It will take about five minutes to process.

zh: 这个需要我们大概十分钟来解决。
old_en: It will take us about ten minutes to solve this, would you mind waiting?
new_en: It will take about ten minutes to resolve this.

zh: 我们的退换货政策是七天内有效。
old_en: Our return and exchange policy is valid for seven days, do you have the receipt?
new_en: Our return and exchange policy is valid for seven days.

zh: 您可以查看我们的退换货政策，通常支持三十天内退换。
old_en: You can check our return and exchange policy, usually we support returns within thirty days.
new_en: You can check our policy; we usually support returns within thirty days.

zh: 您可以登录账户查看退款进度。
old_en: You can log in to your account to check the refund progress.
new_en: You can log in to your account to check the refund status.

zh: 您可以通过电子邮件接收进度更新通知。
old_en: We can send you progress update notifications via email.
new_en: We can send you update notifications via email.

zh: 非常抱歉给您带来不便。
old_en: We are very sorry for the inconvenience this has caused you.
new_en: We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

zh: 对于给您造成的困扰，我们深感歉意。
old_en: We are deeply sorry for any trouble this has caused you.
new_en: We sincerely apologize for the trouble caused.

zh: 我们可以为您安排快递或自取，您看哪种方便？
old_en: Which is more convenient for you, delivery or pickup?
new_en: Would you prefer delivery or pickup?

zh: 您可以选择在线支付或货到付款，您觉得哪种合适？
old_en: Which payment method is better for you, online payment or cash on delivery?
new_en: Do you prefer online payment or cash on delivery?

zh: 请告诉我您的地址，方便我们寄送商品。
old_en: Could you please tell us your address so we can send the item?
new_en: Please share your address so we can ship the item.

zh: 请您提供联系电话，我们需要与您确认一些细节。
old_en: Could you give us your phone number so we can confirm some details?
new_en: Please provide your phone number so we can confirm some details with you.

zh: 退款通常会在两到三个工作日内到账，请您留意。
old_en: Your refund will usually arrive within two to three working days, please keep an eye on it.
new_en: The refund usually arrives within two to three working days, so please keep an eye out for it.

zh: 您的退款预计在一到两天内完成，请耐心等待。
old_en: Your refund is expected to be completed within one to two days, please be patient.
new_en: Your refund is expected to be completed within one to two days, so please wait patiently.

zh: 感谢您的来电，祝您生活愉快，再见。
old_en: Thank you for calling, wishing you a happy life, goodbye.
new_en: Thank you for calling. Have a wonderful day and goodbye.

zh: 有问题请随时联系我们，再见，祝您一天好心情。
old_en: Feel free to contact us if you have any issues, goodbye, wishing you a good day.
new_en: Feel free to contact us if you have any questions. Goodbye and have a great day.
